label: Through-self and through-another versus distinct efficient esse-cause
term: through-self and through-another versus distinct efficient esse-cause
resolution: The new Context represents being-through with target first and source second, admitting self-links in the nonproductive source sense. The q3 efficient esse-cause reading has a distinct actual source and is not this relation by definition. No identity with grounds, self-production, ordinary Causes, fact explanations or modal necessity is imported. Ultimate-source existence and uniqueness concern the same selected actual world and relation; source actuality is explicit and an ultimate candidate can acquire a self-link only through coverage. Distinct selfPowerFrom and through relations preserve HVEP2 as a substantive interface. The distinctGroundProfile adapter selects only through w TARGET SOURCE edges with SOURCE ≠ TARGET, retaining an independently supplied concrete predicate and the same ontic identity/existence. Local ancestry assumptions must be established for this derived relation; source actuality and concrete-source closure are separately required to upgrade its concrete grounding root to an unrestricted through-root. Neither productive self-causation nor real explanatory adequacy is inferred from the adapter.
